# Serphouse

High Volume API for SEO companies, data mining services, and SEO Tool Suite as a SaaS.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/serphouse/.

## Actions

- **Execute SERP Live POST Search** (read-only): Execute real-time search requests and retrieve search engine results immediately using HTTP POST method.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Retrieve account information including active plan, credit usage, and account details.
- **Get Language List** (read-only): Retrieve full list of languages supported by Google, Bing, and Yahoo for SERP requests.
- **Get Trend Search Results** (read-only): Retrieve the results of a completed trend search query.
- **Google Jobs Search** (read-only): Perform real-time Google Jobs search to retrieve job listings.
- **Perform Google Trends Search** (read-only): Perform real-time Google Trends search to retrieve trend data for specified keywords.
- **Schedule Google SERP Advanced Search**: Schedule Google SERP scraping tasks that fetch up to 100 results by iterating through multiple result pages.
- **Schedule Google Trends Search**: Schedule Google Trends search tasks with configuration for keywords, time ranges, and geographic locations.
- **Schedule SERP Tasks**: Schedule SERP search tasks for asynchronous processing.
- **Search Locations** (read-only): Search and retrieve available locations for SERP API from Google or Bing geographical targeting data.
- **SERP Live Search (GET)** (read-only): Execute real-time search requests and retrieve search engine results immediately via HTTP GET.
- **Check SERP Task Status** (read-only): Check the status of a previously submitted SERP task.
- **Check Trend Search Status** (read-only): Check the status of a previously submitted trend search task.
- **Get Domain List** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive list of search engine domains supported by the SERP API including Google, Bing, and Yahoo.
- **Get Trends Categories List** (read-only): Retrieve the full list of categories and subcategories for Google Trends searches.
- **Get Trends Country List** (read-only): Retrieve the full list of countries and states for Google Trends searches.
- **Get Trends Language List** (read-only): Retrieve the full list of supported languages for Google Trends searches.
- **Get Trends Timezone List** (read-only): Retrieve full list of timezones and offset values for use in Google Trend search requests.
